speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; can you tell me how old you are in days and when the rash first appeared?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Ophthalmia (with secondary disseminated rash). The history of maternal gonorrhea and the timing (onset at day 3-4) are highly suggestive; please proceed immediately with Gram stain and culture of ocular and skin lesions, and initiate parenteral ceftriaxone.
